purpose: IPO Terminal transcript-backed application decision knowledge

sources.title: How to Select Better IPO - Veegaland vs Manika comparison
summary: When two IPOs are in a similar bracket and a user has money for only one lot, compare issue size, fresh issue/OFS, PAT margin, P/E, debt-to-equity and expected listing-gain sentiment.
For the Veegaland versus Manika comparison, issue sizes were treated as similar enough that no ranking advantage was given there: Veegaland ₹210 crore and Manika ₹125 crore.
Fresh issue was a clear Veegaland advantage: Veegaland was described as 100% fresh issue, while Manika was described as about 73% fresh and 27% OFS.
PAT margin gave Veegaland a small edge: about 10% versus Manika about 8%.
P/E was treated as essentially a tie: about 17 for Veegaland versus 18 for Manika.
Debt-to-equity was a clear Veegaland advantage: 0.32 versus Manika 0.59.
GMP/listing-gain expectations were described as broadly similar and should not decide the comparison by themselves.
Final one-lot verdict in the transcript: put the one-lot money in Veegaland, whether the category is retail, small HNI or big HNI.
Final two-lot verdict: one lot in Veegaland and one lot in Manika.
Final three-lot verdict: first lot Manika, second lot Veegaland, third lot Veegaland; the speaker additionally discussed using multiple accounts for the third Veegaland application.
The transcript also says funds should be kept in mind for the other IPOs closing in the same bracket, including Hero Motors, Jindal, SS, Sonaselection and NSE.
Broker promotional content in the transcript is not part of IPO selection logic and must not affect IPO ranking.

comparison.verdict: Similar bracket / no decisive ranking advantage

application_decisions.output: For each category, IPO type and total lot budget, show transcript-backed first preference, allocation by IPO, allocated lots, IPO type and application amount.
application_decisions.amount_rule: upper price × lot size × allocated lots
application_decisions.gmp_rule: GMP/listing-gain sentiment is secondary and cannot override the transcript's explicit comparison verdict
application_decisions.missing_data_rule: Missing data lowers confidence; do not invent values.

transcript_rules.pair: Veegaland Developers Limited vs Manika Plastech Limited

one_lot.verdict: FIRST PREFERENCE - apply one lot in Veegaland

two_lots.verdict: One lot Veegaland + one lot Manika

three_lots.verdict: First lot Manika, second lot Veegaland, third lot Veegaland
three_lots.third_lot_note: Transcript discusses applying the third Veegaland lot through another family/multiple account; the terminal should display this as source-derived commentary, not automate account creation or submission.

one_lot_decision.purpose: Rank IPOs for one-lot budget using the user's supplied transcript when the relevant IPO comparison is covered.
reasons: GMP not used as the primary reason

transcript_ingestion.priority: user-provided transcript > educational summary > generic model knowledge
transcript_ingestion.next_action: Use future transcripts to extend the rules while preserving this transcript as the source for the Veegaland-Manika comparison.
